tasks.title: Announcement #45
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: Students, I'd like to invite you to participate in a unique optional assignment. We'll be conducting a field study at the local nature reserve next Friday, observing frogs and sampling water conditions to see if water pollution has an impact on frog behavior. This is an excellent opportunity to apply what we've learned in class to a real world environment. It's free to participate, but we can only have 30 students, so don't wait to sign up.

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what can the listeners do next Friday?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：根据说话者的说法，听众下周五可以做什么？ 定 位 原 文 ： We'll be conducting a field study at the local nature reserve next Friday, observing frogs and sampling water conditions... 选项分析： A. 提交作业。说话者提到的是一项可选作业，但下周五是进行实地研究，而非提交作业，因此 A 选项错误。 B. 去实地考察。原文明确说明下周五将在当地自然保护区进行实地研究，因此 B 选项正确。 C. 报名参加一个机会。报名是需要提前做的动作，而不是下周五当天的活动，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 做展示。说话者没有提到任何展示活动，因此 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker tell students not to wait?

options.A: Late sign-ups can only be done in person.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：为什么说话者让学生们不要等待？ 定位原文：It's free to participate, but we can only have 30 students, so don't wait to sign up. 选项分析： A. 迟报名只能亲自办理。文本中没有提到报名方式的变化，因此 A 选项错误。 B. 迟报名需要付费。文本明确说参与是免费的，没有提到迟报名收费，因此 B 选项错误。 C. 自然保护区关门早。文本中没有提到自然保护区关门时间，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 名额有限。文本明确指出只能容纳 30 名学生，因此需要尽早报名，不要等待，因此 D选项正确。
